For an existing workspace file named in the request but absent from the selected source list, inspect it with the workspace read tools. Read text-only source records without materializing them.

Before closing a file result, reconcile the current requested outputs with the successful publication receipts and select their final available artifact IDs. If the host asks you to recover a missing publication, republish the affected output from the existing file and carry forward the confirmed IDs and evidence for the other outputs. Bind source claims to the shortest exact excerpts from successful reads. Correct a rejected citation with a smaller exact excerpt from the recorded read.
